PIYUSH MALIK

+91 70177 62554 | piyushmalik865@gmail.com | India | linkedin.com/in/piyush-malik-security-analyst/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Security Professional with 7 years of experience in Penetration Testing, Source Code Review, Security Assessments, Threat Modeling, Security/Secure Architecture Review, Security Automation, Compliance and Red Teaming.

EDUCATION

Yeshiva University USA Master's, cybersecurity

August 2023 - September 2024

IIITB Associate's, cybersecurity

August 2022 - August 2023

Jaipur National University Bachelor's, Computer Engineering

January 2019 - June 2022

CERTIFICATIONS

Offensive Security Certified Professional(OSCP) Advanced Diploma in Cybersecurity(ACP)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

AT&T Senior Product Security Engineer

Dallas, TX, USA February 2024 - March 2025

Leading product security for apps/services including threat modeling, pentesting and SDLC/DevSecOps integration. • Conducting secure code reviews, application assessments and mentoring junior engineers to scale security practices. • Driving LLM/AI security by assessing risks, testing prompt injection/adversarial ML and advising on safe deployments. • Handling incident response and security monitoring by investigating threats, analyzing logs and ensuring rapid recovery. Gurgaon, HR, India June 2022 - August 2023

Orange Business Services

Senior Information Security Analyst - Software Engineer

Conducted continuous pentesting, code reviews, threat modeling and security architecture reviews for 80+ internal/external apps, identifying and remediating 500+ critical vulnerabilities across web/mobile/API/network and cloud (AWS/Azure).

Strengthened Salesforce CRM with encryption, MFA, and secure access controls, reducing unauthorized access by 25%, and delivered company-wide security training to foster a security-first culture.

Automated vulnerability management in Secure SDLC/CI-CD using Bash/Python with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools, cutting testing time by 50%, and led infra VA achieving 95% remediation in 30 days.

Airtel Security Engineer(Red Team)

Noida, UP, India August 2021 - June 2022



Improved security via DevSecOps, Threat Modeling, Architecture Review, Penetration Testing, and automated pre/post-deployment checks in CI/CD pipelines, reducing SDLC vulnerabilities by 40%.

Led Red Team assessments uncovering critical flaws, boosting network security by 25%, and conducted tests across web, API, cloud (AWS/Azure), and mobile, collaborating on 300+ remediations for compliance.

Recon Cyber Security Information Security Analyst

Delhi, India November 2019 - August 2021

Secured and managed the security of 50+ applications via Threat-modeling, Architecture-Review, Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing, SAST, and DAST, reducing zero-day exploit risk by 50%, with proactive threat detection, real-time vulnerability management and secure coding.

Managed vulnerabilities with trackers and tickets achieving 90% remediation in 30 days and trained 150+ employees.

Softvet Cyber Security Information Security Analyst

Luanda, LU, Angola March 2018 - September 2019 • Continuously led vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and code review for 1000+ infrastructure assets and 25+ applications,

identifying and mitigating high-risk vulnerabilities while guiding developers on secure coding practices.

Automated scans for 95% critical systems, reducing manual work by 35% and decreasing security incidents by 20%.

SKILLS

Skills: Network Security, Web Application Security, Mobile Application Security, Appsec, Cloud Security – AWS, AZURE, API Security – REST API, GraphQL, Threat Modelling, Red Teaming, DevSecOps, Secure CI/CD, Secure SDLC, WAF, Vulnerability Management, Code Review, Vulnerability Assessment, Risk Assessment, GDPR, Reporting, SAST and DAST, Architecture Review, Secure Architecture, Salesforce Security, Salesforce Admin, Python, Bash, Java, Go, Linux-Parrot, Kali-Linux, Arch-Linux, Windows, MacOS, AD, Servers, Linux/Unix, AI Security, LLM Security, LLM Testing, AI Testing
